items.title: When you need standalone engine inspection
items.description: Engines Market connects you with vetted UK engine inspectors who offer standalone inspection services - so you can verify the condition of a used engine before you commit to purchase or installation.

cards.title: Use Case 1: Before You Buy a Used Engine
cards.text: You've found a used engine online - eBay, Facebook Marketplace, a breaker's yard. The price looks good. But you don't know the engine's actual condition. Inspection reveals cylinder health, hidden damage, and whether the mileage is believable.
cards.icon: 🔍 Use Case 1: Before You Buy a Used Engine

But you don't know the engine's actual condition. Inspection reveals cylinder health, hidden damage, and whether the mileage is believable. Best for: Used engine buyers, importers, breakers, DIY enthusiasts, collectors

cards.title: Use Case 2: Before You Fit a Used Engine
cards.text: You've already purchased a used engine. You're about to pay £800-£2,000 for fitting. You want to know if the engine is sound before you spend money on installation. Inspection confirms if the engine is serviceable and reveals any hidden issues.

items.title: What's included in a standalone engine inspection
items.description: A professional inspection covers the critical mechanical condition of your engine. Here's what a typical inspection includes:

cards.title: 🔍 External Visual Inspection
cards.text: External condition, casing cracks, corrosion, ancillaries condition, sealing surfaces - identifies visible damage.
cards.fullText: 🔍 External Visual Inspection External condition, casing cracks, corrosion, ancillaries condition, sealing surfaces - identifies visible damage.

cards.title: 📊 Compression Test
cards.text: Cylinder pressure measured for all cylinders (engine rotated on stand) - reveals worn piston rings, damaged valves, head gasket issues.
cards.fullText: 📊 Compression Test Cylinder pressure measured for all cylinders (engine rotated on stand) - reveals worn piston rings, damaged valves, head gasket issues.

cards.title: 💨 Leak-Down Test
cards.text: How well each cylinder holds pressure - pinpoints exact cause of compression loss (valves, rings, head gasket).
cards.fullText: 💨 Leak-Down Test How well each cylinder holds pressure - pinpoints exact cause of compression loss (valves, rings, head gasket).

cards.title: 🔬 Borescope Inspection
cards.text: Internal view of cylinders, piston crowns, cylinder walls - reveals scoring, damage, carbon buildup, overheating marks.
cards.fullText: 🔬 Borescope Inspection Internal view of cylinders, piston crowns, cylinder walls - reveals scoring, damage, carbon buildup, overheating marks.

cards.title: 🛢️ Oil Condition Check (Basic)
cards.text: Colour, smell, presence of metal particles - indicates internal wear, contamination, or neglect.
cards.fullText: 🛢️ Oil Condition Check (Basic) Colour, smell, presence of metal particles - indicates internal wear, contamination, or neglect.

cards.title: 🧪 Oil Analysis (Optional - extra cost)
cards.text: Metal content, contamination, viscosity - detects internal wear, coolant contamination, fuel dilution.
cards.fullText: 🧪 Oil Analysis (Optional - extra cost) Metal content, contamination, viscosity - detects internal wear, coolant contamination, fuel dilution.

cards.title: ⏱️ Timing Component Check
cards.text: Condition of timing belt/chain, tensioners, guides (if accessible) - prevents catastrophic timing failure.
cards.fullText: ⏱️ Timing Component Check Condition of timing belt/chain, tensioners, guides (if accessible) - prevents catastrophic timing failure.

cards.title: 🔧 Ancillary Assessment
cards.text: Inspection of ancillaries (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter) if still attached - identifies which may need replacement.
cards.fullText: 🔧 Ancillary Assessment Inspection of ancillaries (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter) if still attached - identifies which may need replacement.

cards.title: 📋 Written Report
cards.text: Written findings, pass/fail status, recommendations, estimated repair costs - a clear, actionable summary.
cards.fullText: 📋 Written Report Written findings, pass/fail status, recommendations, estimated repair costs - a clear, actionable summary.

items.title: The "Fail" scenarios
items.description: Some inspection findings mean you should walk away - every time.

cards.text: Indicates worn rings, damaged valves, or head gasket failure.
cards.fullText: ❌ Low compression on one or more cylinders Indicates worn rings, damaged valves, or head gasket failure. → Walk away - rebuild cost may exceed engine value

cards.text: Internal damage - requires rebore or replacement.
cards.fullText: ❌ Scoring on cylinder walls (borescope) Internal damage - requires rebore or replacement. → Walk away - not economically repairable

cards.text: Structural damage - cannot be repaired.
cards.fullText: ❌ Crack in engine block or cylinder head Structural damage - cannot be repaired. → Walk away - engine is scrap

cards.text: Internal wear - bearings, rings, or other components failing.
cards.fullText: ❌ Metal particles in oil (oil analysis) Internal wear - bearings, rings, or other components failing. → Walk away - full rebuild likely needed

cards.text: Engine has been overheated - risk of warping and future failure.
cards.fullText: ❌ Signs of overheating (discoloured components) Engine has been overheated - risk of warping and future failure. → Walk away - may appear fine but fail shortly after fitting

cards.text: Cooling system neglect - risk of overheating and failure.
cards.fullText: ❌ Corrosion in coolant passages Cooling system neglect - risk of overheating and failure. → Walk away - may have hidden damage

cards.text: Chain/belt worn - risk of catastrophic failure.
cards.fullText: ⚠️ Timing component damage (visible) Chain/belt worn - risk of catastrophic failure. → Walk away - unless the price reflects the risk

items.title: What specialists say
items.description: Insights drawn from interviews with UK engine specialists who regularly inspect standalone engines. [EM-INTERVIEW]

blocks.text: "A customer bought a used engine online for £1,200. The seller said it was 'tested and running.' The customer spent £800 getting it fitted - then the engine seized 200 miles later. If they'd spent £200 on a pre-fit inspection, the scored cylinder would have been visible on the borescope - and they'd have saved £2,000 in fitting and replacement costs."

"Photos of a used engine on eBay show the outside. They don't show the cylinder walls. They don't show the compression figures. They don't show the metal in the oil. A borescope inspection reveals what the seller isn't telling you - and what they might not even know themselves."

"Engine importers bring in containers of used engines from Japan and Europe. They can't trust the paperwork alone. They inspect every engine on the stand before it goes into stock - compression, borescope, oil analysis. The inspection is their quality control."

items.title: Common questions about standalone engine inspection

blocks.question: How much does a standalone engine inspection cost? −
blocks.answer: Basic visual £100-£150, standard £150-£250, full £200-£350, comprehensive £300-£500. Prices vary by engine type and region. [EM-QUOTE]

blocks.question: What's the difference between this service and the vehicle-based inspection? +
blocks.answer: Vehicle-based inspection is for engines fitted in a vehicle. This service is for standalone engines on a stand or pallet - for used engine buyers, importers, and pre-fit verification.

blocks.question: When should I get a standalone engine inspection? +
blocks.answer: Before buying a used engine online, before paying for fitting, or if you've already bought an engine and want to verify its condition before installation.

blocks.question: What does the inspection include? +
blocks.answer: External visual inspection, compression test, leak-down test, borescope inspection, oil condition check, timing component check (if accessible), and a written report with pass/fail status.

blocks.question: What if the engine fails the inspection? +
blocks.answer: If pre-purchase - walk away. If pre-fit - do not fit. The inspection report gives you the evidence to negotiate a refund or avoid wasting labour costs.

blocks.question: Can I get the inspection done before I buy the engine? +
blocks.answer: Yes - if the seller is willing to allow the inspection. Some sellers may not allow it - that's a red flag in itself.

blocks.question: Do I need to send my engine to the workshop? +
blocks.answer: Yes - the engine needs to be physically at the workshop for inspection. You can deliver it or arrange transport.

blocks.question: What if the engine is still installed in a vehicle? +
blocks.answer: Use the vehicle-based engine inspection service instead - it's designed for engines fitted in cars.
